name: Megadeth

whyMatters.en: Dave Mustaine’s thrash band after leaving Metallica. Rust in Peace (1990) set a high mark for technical riff density and precision lead guitar in thrash.
whyMatters.zh: Dave Mustaine 离开 Metallica 后的 thrash 乐队。Rust in Peace（1990）在 thrash 中把技术 riff 密度与精密主音吉他推到高点。

note.en: Rust in Peace opener; tempo shifts plus Friedman leads.
note.zh: Rust in Peace 开场；速度切换加 Friedman 主音。

note.en: Conspiracy lyric over escalating solo trade-offs.
note.zh: 阴谋论歌词上的升级独奏对位。

note.en: Bass intro and Mustaine snarl; MTV news bumper fame.
note.zh: 贝斯前奏与 Mustaine 咆哮；MTV 新闻片头成名。

shortBio.en: Mustaine thrash after the Metallica firing; Rust in Peace is the technical peak.
shortBio.zh: Mustaine 被 Metallica 开除后的 thrash；Rust in Peace 是技术峰值。

body.en:
Formed in 1983 after Mustaine left Metallica. Peace Sells builds the US thrash profile. Rust in Peace (1990) with Friedman and Menza is the precision thrash peak. Countdown to Extinction adds radio cuts.

Lineup churn is constant; Mustaine and riff density stay central. Rivalry with Metallica remains the origin story.

The book files Megadeth with Metallica, Slayer, and Anthrax as the thrash Big Four. Mustaine, just out of Metallica, formed the band in 1984 with David Ellefson. He later called Killing Is My Business… and Business Is Good! (1985) a $4,000 mess. Peace Sells… but Who’s Buying? (1986) is the first hit album, with Chris Poland and Gar Samuelson; the book says all four were using drugs and that Mustaine’s public insults put the band at odds with Slayer and Pantera. Marty Friedman and Nick Menza play on So Far, So Good… So What! (1988) and Rust in Peace (1990). Countdown to Extinction (1992) and Youthanasia (1994) made the US top 5. Cryptic Writings (1997) was the last US top-10 million-seller in the entry; Risk (1999) and The World Needs a Hero (2001) move softer. An arm injury stopped Mustaine playing; Ellefson sued; the band stopped. The System Has Failed (2004) is the return. Ellefson came back in 2010 for the Big Four tour Metallica put together, and for Th1rt3en.
body.zh:
Mustaine 离开 Metallica 后于 1983 组建。Peace Sells 建立美国 thrash 轮廓。与 Friedman、Menza 的 Rust in Peace（1990）是精密 thrash 峰值。Countdown to Extinction 加入电台曲。

阵容动荡是常量；Mustaine 与 riff 密度仍居中心。与 Metallica 的对峙仍是起源故事。

书中把 Megadeth 与 Metallica、Slayer、Anthrax 并列为鞭挞金属“四大”。刚离开 Metallica 的 Mustaine 1984 年与 David Ellefson 建队。他后来说 Killing Is My Business… and Business Is Good!（1985）是用 4000 美元做成的烂录音。Peace Sells… but Who’s Buying?（1986）是首张热门专辑，吉他 Chris Poland、鼓 Gar Samuelson；书中写当时四人都在用毒品，Mustaine 当众嘲讽还与 Slayer、Pantera 结怨。Marty Friedman 与 Nick Menza 参加 So Far, So Good… So What!（1988）和 Rust in Peace（1990）。Countdown to Extinction（1992）与 Youthanasia（1994）进美国前五。条目里 Cryptic Writings（1997）是最后一张美国前十的百万销量专辑；Risk（1999）与 The World Needs a Hero（2001）转向更柔。Mustaine 手臂受伤不能弹吉他；Ellefson 起诉；乐队停下。The System Has Failed（2004）是回归。Ellefson 2010 年回来，参加 Metallica 发起的“四大”巡演，并录 Th1rt3en。

title.zh: Thrash 对峙作为第二条路径

body.en:
Mustaine leaves Metallica in 1983 and builds a faster, more chromatic riff approach. Peace Sells is the street face; Rust in Peace is the technical exam.

Big Four seat earned mainly by riff density.
body.zh:
Mustaine 1983 离开 Metallica，建更快、更半音化的 riff 写法。Peace Sells 是街头脸；Rust in Peace 是技术考试。

四大席位主要靠 riff 密度赢得。

title.en: Rust in Peace four as peak
title.zh: Rust in Peace 四人即巅峰

body.en:
Peak: Mustaine / Friedman / Ellefson / Menza (about 1990–94). Earlier Poland era is rawer. Later casts rotate guitar and drums heavily.

Chronicle peak flag on the Rust lineup—technical thrash standard.
body.zh:
巅峰：Mustaine / Friedman / Ellefson / Menza（约 1990–94）。更早 Poland 时期更糙。后来吉他与鼓大量轮换。

编年史巅峰旗在 Rust 阵容——技术 thrash 标准。

title.en: Mustaine bark, Friedman leads, Ellefson bass
title.zh: Mustaine 吠叫、Friedman 主音、Ellefson 贝斯

body.en:
Mustaine: Jackson/Flying V thrash riffs, snarl vocal. Friedman: neo-classical and exotic leads. Ellefson: precise alternate-picked bass. Menza: double-bass clarity.

When Friedman and Menza exit, density drops even if the band name stays.
body.zh:
Mustaine：Jackson/Flying V thrash riff、咆哮人声。Friedman：新古典与异域主音。Ellefson：精密交替拨贝斯。Menza：双底鼓清晰。

Friedman 与 Menza 离开后，即使乐队名在，密度也降。

alt.zh: Dave Mustaine 与 Megadeth，马德里，2008

body.en:
Rust opener. Fast A section, mid-tempo crush, solo duel. Politics in the lyric without a power-ballad exit.

Clear thrash composition reference track.
body.zh:
Rust 开场。快速 A 段、中速压迫、独奏对决。歌词有政治，无强力谣曲出走。

清晰的 thrash 作曲参照曲。

body.en:
Conspiracy narrative over escalating leads. MTV plays the video; guitarists learn the trade-offs.

Technical thrash that still charts.
body.zh:
阴谋叙事盖在升级主音上。MTV 播影像；吉他手学对位交替。

仍能上榜的技术 thrash。

title.zh: 对着 Metallica 的四大边

body.en:
Origin story (the firing) keeps the Metallica link visible. Rust in Peace remains the precision citation beside Slayer aggression and Metallica groove.

Hub person: Mustaine. No Hetfield person file yet—band-level edge only.
body.zh:
起源故事（开除）让 Metallica 链接可见。Rust in Peace 仍是精密引用，旁边是 Slayer 攻击与 Metallica 律动。

枢纽人物：Mustaine。尚无 Hetfield person——仅乐队级边。

note.zh: Mustaine、Ellefson、Poland、Samuelson。书中写这一段有毒品，并与 Slayer、Pantera 公开结怨。

note.en: Technical thrash opener that set the Rust-era standard.
note.zh: 定下 Rust 时期标准的技术 thrash 开场。

note.en: Post-Metallica thrash rival; precision as the central trait.
note.zh: Metallica 后的 thrash 对峙者；精密是核心特征。
